lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately ten horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region, following the longitudinal curvature of the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity forming a matrix with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating distinct anchor nodes across the central lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a high-contrast transition between light-reflecting dorsal edges and shadowed ventral edges, extending from the gill area to the caudal peduncle.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse, low-contrast high-luminance blobs are visible on the leading edge and base of the first dorsal fin silhouette, though resolution is lower than the primary flank.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark-pigmented Echeneidae specimen (remora) attached to the ventral-lateral region just posterior to the left pectoral fin.
